# Kevin Lewis

Kevin Lewis is the current Connétable of [St Saviour](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2005.

Kevin Lewis has participated in 9 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis#e3)

  Not elected.
- [**2004 Senator By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis#e5)

  Not elected.
- [**2005 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis#e6)

  Not elected.
- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis#e7)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 with 44.4% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis#e12)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 with 67.8% of the ballot.
- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 with 69.1% of the ballot.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111206074355/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-saviour-district-2/kevin-lewis)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928175814/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=76)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 with 73.2% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/kevin-lewis-3/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PY2lOiVq2nk)
- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 with 70.6% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/kevin-lewis-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qtKShF1cIFs)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rNVdDeTFslw)
- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of St Saviour.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/kevin-lewis/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aAURCXHmSq8)

Kevin Lewis has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Saviour](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/19/st-saviour-constable-to-stand-for-re-election/)\]
